title: Automated VPC cutover validations with chaos integration
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated validation harness that runs end-to-end cutover rehearsals for Private (VPC) deployments with integrated chaos experiments and deterministic verification.

Background: We currently have several DR playbooks and region failover runbooks, but many steps are manual (Terraform apply/plan inspection, traffic shift, cache warmup, model priming). Past rehearsals have exposed issues: stale Terraform state mismatch during fast cutovers, KV cache cold-start leading to long tail latencies, and missing routing checks for private peering.

Proposed approach:
1) Create a reusable Terraform module wrapper (private-dr-harness) that: captures a read-only plan snapshot, performs a dry-run verification, and can toggle routing policies (primary/secondary) using feature flags.
2) Integrate a Chaos Mesh job set to inject networking disruptions (TCP resets, delayed peering), API-layer throttling, and simulated storage latency during the rehearsal window.
3) Build a validation suite that runs synthetic traffic (from regional agents) exercising: health checks, model inference end-to-end, KV cache hit ratios, and latency P95/P99 SLOs. The suite will automatically compare results against baseline dashboards.
4) Implement automatic rollback criteria in the harness: if latency or error-rate thresholds exceed configured limits, the harness triggers Terraform promotion back to the primary and records a failure artifact.
5) Add a post-run artifact collector that uploads plan diffs, Prometheus snapshots, Gateway traces, and a run-summary to Confluence and the DR dashboard for later analysis.

Trade-offs considered:
- Running chaos during cutovers increases rehearsal fidelity but adds risk. To mitigate, rehearsals are constrained to isolated test accounts and use canary routing first.
- Tight coupling with Chaos Mesh may limit cloud portability; we will keep chaos interface pluggable so teams can replace the chaos executor with alternatives (e.g., Istio fault injection) if needed.

Deliverables: Terraform module, chaos job templates, validation runner, dashboard widgets, runbook update, and automated postmortem template.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Terraform wrapper module (private-dr-harness) exists in infra/terraform/modules/private-dr-harness and includes plan snapshot and toggle flags
A Chaos Mesh (or pluggable executor) job library for network/storage/API disruptions is available and documented
Validation runner executes synthetic traffic from >=2 regions and asserts health-check, KV hit-rate, and latency SLOs automatically
Automated rollback triggers on predefined thresholds and executes Terraform to revert routing/policy changes
Three successful rehearsal runs in the staging VPC with recorded artifacts (plan diffs, Prometheus export, traces) uploaded to Confluence
Runbook and DR dashboard updated with new test results and an exported postmortem template for failures
tasks: Design Terraform wrapper API and feature flags
Implement chaos job templates (network delay, connection reset, storage latency)
Develop validation runner (golang service) with region agents
